name: aegischat
description: Zero-Knowledge End-to-End Encrypted Messaging Platform with Signal Double Ratchet & X3DH

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "RELAY,CLIENT" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgCyan.bold" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:rust && npm run test:crypto && npm run test:security
scripts.test:live: npm run test:e2e && npm run test:groups && npm run test:calling && npm run test:mesh && npm run test:attachments && npm run test:pairing && npm run test:censorship
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix client exec tsc -- -b --noEmit && npm --prefix server exec tsc -- --noEmit
scripts.mobile:android: npm --prefix client run tauri android dev
scripts.mobile:android:init: npm --prefix client run tauri android init
scripts.mobile:android:build: npm --prefix client run tauri android build --apk
scripts.mobile:ios: npm --prefix client run tauri ios dev
scripts.mobile:ios:init: npm --prefix client run tauri ios init
scripts.mobile:ios:build: npm --prefix client run tauri ios build
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build && npm run build:rust
